transcript: Yesterday, my friend Sylvia and I went to Safety Not Guaranteed at BAM. In it, a journalist sees an ad looking for someone to go back in time with, and being intrigued, they inquire, hoping to get a really juicy story out of it. This is a new musical based on a film neither of us have seen, and it feels like a work in progress. Now they're in early previews so I'm willing to overlook some of the sound quality and pacing issues, but the storytelling was also kind of weak to me. It felt like it was a lot of underdeveloped characters, a lot of time spent on non-central plot lines, and I don't necessarily blame the writers of this adaptation, I'm just not convinced that the source material has enough potential to musicalize. Which is kind of a shame because I actually really enjoyed the musical style and the orchestrations, regardless of the fact that I felt the score too seems in progress. Anyway, I don't know how long they have till opening night but I'm sure they're continuing to sharpen this piece as best they can. I wonder if it was ready for fully staged production at this point, but here we are. With that, another program for my collection.
